title: Reachability depends only on the edge set
statement: Fix $n \in \bbn$, and let $l_1$ and $l_2$ be two lists of weighted edges on the vertex set $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ that have the same members, i.e.\ $x \in l_1 \Leftrightarrow x \in l_2$ for every weighted edge $x$. Then for any vertices $a, b \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n$, the vertex $b$ is reachable from $a$ through the edges of $l_1$ if and only if it is reachable from $a$ through the edges of $l_2$.
hypotheses_covered: l1 and l2 have the same members (∀ x, x ∈ l1 ↔ x ∈ l2)
a, b are vertices in Fin n
replaced:
If two edge lists $l_1$ and $l_2$ have the same elements (i.e.\
$\forall x,\; x \in l_1 \leftrightarrow x \in l_2$), then
$\mathtt{Reach}\,l_1\,a\,b \leftrightarrow \mathtt{Reach}\,l_2\,a\,b$.
